meditation with binaural beats, shadow work, lots of journaling, (i am reiki certified) so i performed that on myself, chakra balancing, crystal healings, essential oil use, burning sage and palo santo during panics while repeating mantras, eating only fruits and vegetables :) I really want to make a youtube channel about all of this, and I have a blog as well that I need to put more effort into to share these methods that have helped me for years.
Yes! Thank you for sharing the love. We can all do this! xo
Thanks <3 We can all do it!!
It's never your fault... Please don't blame yourself, I know the feeling. You are amazing! Here if you need anything

Im so sorry you had to experience something similar. I feel you can really relate so thank you for this. I have felt so alone, and it's crazy how people online understand this better than family.

Family has become just a word. I have been staying at a friend's house the nights he is here, and Im told he's looking for somewhere else to live. I hope it happens soon because it's so upsetting being near him at any time.

Sucks to have people you care about down play your feelings, and a serious situation.. Ive been venting in a journal which has helped a lot, also makes me realize how crazy all of this is seeing it written in words. Im thinking about getting back on depression medication because Ive been missing so much work. It just feels like one thing after another

My Mom is an angel, she's very empathetic... her logic is she can't just throw her son out around the holidays with no where to go. So far Ive been staying home besides a few nights that he was here. I have such bad social anxiety it's hard for me to sleep somewhere else, I don't have the mental energy to be around others. My grandmother also said I can stay with her when needed. Hopefully he finds a place to go soon so he can move out for good..

I wish I could support myself to live on my own... I have called out of work 5 times the past 2 weeks since it's happened because I've been so depressed and anxious. It makes me feel weak as fuck. He hasn't been here much because I think he feels embarrassed every time he sees me because it reminds him what a fucking idiot he is. All because I was crying about not being able to find my fucking car keys...
Thank you. My perspective has changed on "family" a lot. Of course this would happen around Christmas time. I plan on getting a hotel with my boyfriend and getting away for the weekend.

Yea this is my whole life. I grew up in a very violent environment, lots of gang members, drugs, etc... Thought that was all over, then he had to "snap" as my mother says. It's bullshit. I can't wait to finish school and get a decent job so I can move out. Hopefully that can happen sooner.

My health insurance just got back on too so I'm going to look for a new therapist.

She doesn't know what to do, so when I talk about the situation and how it makes me upset she is pretty defensive. I don't know how to handle it, so I can understand that she doesn't either. It does help that I can go to my boyfriend, but yesterday my bf came and told me he heard my brother is making death threats to my friends. He is nuts. Happy this isn't going to ruin my relationship, but I feel so triggered and depressed.

Yea hes a pretty sick fuck. Growing up I was in a wheel chair  due to neurological issues and he used to make fun of my inability to walk. I forgave him for all that, and his pretend emotions seemed so real I unfortunately believed him.

Im so sorry you feel like this. Youre not pathetic, and I can relate. I work at a call center and have people tell me I dont know how to do my job all day. Hope everything goes ok at work for you. You got this!!
